active_watches.headline: Tornado Watch issued September 14 at 10:28PM CDT until September 15 at 12:00AM CDT by NWS Des Moines IA
active_watches.description:
TORNADO WATCH 669 REMAINS VALID UNTIL MIDNIGHT CDT TONIGHT FOR
THE FOLLOWING AREAS

IN IOWA THIS WATCH INCLUDES 8 COUNTIES

IN SOUTH CENTRAL IOWA

CLARKE                MADISON               RINGGOLD
UNION                 WARREN

IN SOUTHWEST IOWA

ADAIR                 ADAMS                 TAYLOR

THIS INCLUDES THE CITIES OF ADAIR, BEDFORD, CARLISLE, CORNING,
CRESTON, EARLHAM, FONTANELLE, GREENFIELD, INDIANOLA, LENOX,
MOUNT AYR, NEW MARKET, NORWALK, OSCEOLA, STUART, AND WINTERSET.

* PRIMARY THREATS INCLUDE...

A COUPLE TORNADOES POSSIBLE.
SCATTERED DAMAGING WINDS AND ISOLATED SIGNIFICANT GUSTS TO 80
MPH LIKELY.
SCATTERED LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED VERY LARGE HAIL EVENTS TO 2
INCHES IN DIAMETER POSSIBLE.
